Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She loved to play in her backyard. One day, she saw a big pile of leaves. She wanted to jump in it.
Lucy's mom saw her looking and said, "Lucy, don't jump in the leaves. It's not safe."
Lucy looked sad. "Why is it not safe?" she asked.
Her mom shook her head. "I don't know," she said. "Maybe when the leaves will go away."

samples.prompt: One day, a little girl named Lily
samples.text:
One day, a little girl named Lily went for a walk in the woods. She saw a big, green tree with pretty leaves. Lily wanted to climb the tree and see if she could.
Lily climbed the tree and saw a big, green, yellow squirrel. "Hello, Mr. Squirrel," she said. "Do you want to climb the tree and explore the forest?" The squirrel nodded and they both climbed the tree together. From that day on, they were good friends and went on many fun adventures together.
